fields.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Twisted Fate''' kills an enemy, he generates {{g|icononly=true}}{{pp|type=chance|1 to 6 for 6|key1=%|100*2/3/5 to 100*2/3/5;100/3|color=gold}}.
